job_spec.purpose: el1013-s81-engram: keepout re-route of the CLOSED leaf dsfd_engram_lkp (engram_lkp_crcmat2_a-b17ee03d4-tc, TT +22.96 / FF +2.33). The closed 10-09 view fails child_lint (f): 250 of 662 face pins have OBS on the layer above, so the dsfd_engram_c cluster router cannot drop a via on them. Same RTL (PIPE=1, CRCMAT=1 synthesis config: without CRCMAT crc reg->reg is -2263 ps pre-layout), outline 324x216, pins, SDC, PD 0.35, HM 0.05; added: PRE_GLOBAL_ROUTE pin_access_pregrt.tcl + POST_DETAIL_ROUTE stn_pin_keepout.tcl, above-only. Cycles unchanged.
